rows.label: tlk70000069_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Did you get the hankering to
search for treasure again?

rows.label: tlk70000069_01_msg0002
rows.name:
Huh? Where's the capital? When you
came through Braying Canyon, wasn't
there a tower-like building ahead?

rows.label: tlk70000069_01_msg0003
rows.name:
That's Aureus Palace in the capital.
Head toward it across the desert and
you'll reach the city eventually.

rows.label: tlk70000069_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Just be careful on the way. A lot of
the monsters in Dana Desert are
vicious.
